title: Scenario 5: Conflicting evidence (low confidence)
description: Alert fires 10 minutes after deployment v2.4.2. While the timing superficially implicates the release, deep logs reveal errors are strictly isolated to stale reads on a lagging database replica (db-replica-02), while the release commit is unrelated client analytics.
